analysis.support_validation: 5/5 support pairs. Paired target-vs-motion:1 signal match (angle-invariant statistics): gm_ratio rel-diff 2.1/0.9/8.3/6.0/4.3%, raw-residual spatial_corr 4.8/0.8/2.2/4.9/0.3%, variance_ratio 0.2/0.1/0.0/1.1/1.0%, spread_ratio 0.0/0.0/0.5/0.3/0.6%, block_boundary 0.3/0.3/0.0/0.5/0.6%, spectral_slope_ratio 3.0/0.1/0.1/2.7/2.1%, dct_zero_ratio 3.4/3.6/0.8/2.0/15.0%. Content-independent CI pass 46/50 (per pair 7,10,10,9,10) vs R0 gaussian:1 37/50 (6,6,8,9,8) and lens:1 40/50 (7,7,9,9,8). Two independent pair0 motion draws give PSNR 25.50/25.34 (angle-shift dominated) but identical global profile (gm 0.4548/0.4623, variance_ratio 0.8988/0.9013, spatial_corr 0.4736/0.4762, spread 0.9357/0.9357) - confirming the discriminating signals are angle-invariant and the PSNR gap is an angle-mismatch artifact, not a family mismatch.
analysis.rationale: R0 modeled the pair as a mild isotropic blur (gaussian:1) but the target violates the isotropic-kernel manifold in a consistent way: variance_ratio matches gaussian:1 exactly (0.897 vs 0.894) while gradients are far less reduced (gm 0.446 vs 0.324) and raw-residual spatial correlation is 3x higher (0.452 vs 0.155), with HF extremes preserved (overshoot 0.49/zc 0.41/hf_lf 0.70 vs 0.24/0.27/0.60). No allowed isotropic kernel at any severity reproduces this (gaussian:2 tested: 28.90 dB, CI 4/10; lens:1, glass:1 both fail the same discriminators). An anisotropic motion kernel (radius 5, sigma 3, random angle) does, on all 5 pairs. PSNR cannot arbitrate a random-angle blur: the two pair0 draws differ only by angle (25.50 vs 25.34 dB) and SKILL C.4 states non-deterministic blurs never reach >40 dB. Per the protocol principle that stochastic components (noise seed, random angle) must be validated by statistical matching rather than PSNR, the candidate passes on >=4/5 pairs with a large margin (5/5; CI +9/50 over control). Residual risk: exact angle is unknowable, so verdict stays UNCERTAIN and training/GT PSNR should arbitrate; if the generator used an out-of-grid elongated kernel the family label is approximate but still far closer than isotropic gaussian:1.
